first_red.independent_presence_evidence: llvm-nm and per-section llvm-objdump both show every reported-missing root in the smoke ELF. They share one VMA by the proven mutually exclusive runtime-overlay design.
first_red.gate_defect: pre_ownership_gate stored parsed functions in a dictionary keyed only by integer VMA. Every new function header at 0xc356 replaced the previous section's root before name_to_address was constructed.
first_red.product_interpretation: This stop does not prove a missing product path and does not prove pre-ownership safety. It proves that a raw-address graph cannot represent lifetime-exclusive overlay sections.

recommended_next_gate_model.node_identity: Represent overlay functions by (section, VMA), never VMA alone.
recommended_next_gate_model.boot_slice_rule: Derive the boot sections from the same BOOT slice specifications that drive packing. Scan every instruction in each boot section, then follow calls leaving that section into the ordinary low-resident graph.
recommended_next_gate_model.same_vma_rule: A target inside the current overlay section resolves section-locally; another section at the same VMA is neither an alias nor a reachable edge because lifetime families and slices are mutually exclusive.
negative_cases: two boot roots at one runtime VMA are both retained as distinct graph nodes
a boot slice direct edge to session-only E000 code is rejected
a boot slice operand into session-only E000 state is rejected
a boot slice edge through the c2e-cons facade vector is rejected
recommended_next_gate_model.product_byte_expectation: zero; proof-model and gate implementation only
recommended_next_gate_model.authorization: A corrected gate and any fresh substitution link require review.

claim_limit: Receipt-less diagnostic first-red only. It confirms the five-byte relocation and exposes a section-alias defect in the new proof gate; it proves no pre-ownership closure, fixed-facade closure, final product identity, capacity, one-truth, KERNAL freedom, hardware behavior or promotion claim.
